Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Joyce Hunter, Darrell Yates Rist, and Tom Stoddard 2. Catholic bishop forbids AIDS Project Los Angeles from holding seminars in Catholic buildings due to the project's endorsement of condom use 3. National Gay Rights Advocates win $3 million settlement for San Francisco homosexuals who were denied employment or promotion by Pacific Bell 4. Discussion of the New York Board of Education's AIDS awareness film, "Sex, Drug, and AIDS" 5. Discussion of bathhouses and the possible reopening of NYC's largest, St Mark's Bathhouse 6. Discussion of the State Department's requirement for HTLVIII testing for applicants and employees COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 7. Andy Humm on refusing to cooperate with AIDS-discriminatory job practices COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 8. World Health Organization finds AIDS rates may soar in Latin America and Asia 9. Justice Sandra Day O'Connor finds that the Supreme Court's decision on the Georgia sodomy case may be altered by further prosecution and hearings 10. Austin, Texas, proposal for banning the discrimination on the basis of sexual preference generally supported 11. Alabama, Birmingham News requires job applicants to take HIV test and bans those positive from jobs 12. Jackson, Mississippi, State bans language of sexual equality from Constitution, opting for ban on "gender" discrimination only 13. San Francisco, National Gay Rights Advocates issue complaint against Health America's rejection of all San Francisco applicants in order to avoid AIDS-positive applicants 14. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 15. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Announcement, 1986 Sydney Gay Mardi Gras program preview party, with clips COMMERCIAL: The Monster 2. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of The High Heeled Women's "It's A Broad, Broad, Broad World," with clips COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 3. "Just Ask Raz" advice segment COMMERCIAL: The World of Video 4. Closing credits
